title: dirname -J record
description: One NAME and its directory, from `dirname -J` (-z does not change the records). Error records (`#/$defs/error`) are in the same stream. One record per line (NDJSON); version 1 of the Dogfish record format (doc/ndjson.md). Fields may be added in later releases.

path_bytes.description: The bytes of `path`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`path` then holds the lossy form).

dir.description: What dirname prints for it: NAME without its last component and the slashes before it; `.` when NAME has no slash.

dir_bytes.description: The bytes of `dir`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`dir` then holds the lossy form).

error.description: An error record: the structured twin of a diagnostic the tool also printed on standard error, in order with the other records.
The diagnostic as printed on standard error, without the `tool: ` prefix.

path.description: The file the diagnostic names first, as given.

path_bytes.description: The bytes of `path`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`path` then holds the lossy form).

errno.description: The system error number, when the diagnostic ends with its message (2 for `No such file or directory`).
